sw.why: Infobox gives L1 5.265M vs L2 92.4M; ours (20) far above infobox L1, total (100) already close to infobox L1+L2 (~98) so kept

ig.why: Infobox nation field marks Igbo as having national-language status in Nigeria (NGA), ours had empty official list; thanks text fixed to include underdot diacritic per Wiktionary 'daalụ'

bm.why: Infobox L1 4.19M/L2 10.0M (total ~14.2M); ours l1=14 and total=18 were both far above infobox

mos.why: Infobox speakers ~11.9M vs ours total 9 (>20% off); Wikidata official_in and infobox nation both list Burkina Faso, ours official list was empty

rn.why: Wikivoyage's neutral Kirundi greeting is 'Muraho'; 'Amahoro' (peace) is the Kinyarwanda (Rwanda) greeting, likely mixed up with the sister language

nso.why: Infobox L1 is 3.23M (2022 census) vs ours 4.7, >20% off; total (13) kept, close to infobox L1+L2 (~12.3)

sg.why: Both Wikidata (0.599M, 2017) and infobox (sag: 617,000) put L1 at ~0.6M, far below ours (1); total (5) kept, close to Wikidata L1+L2 (~5.2)

hak.unsure: Speaker counts conflict: Wikidata gives L1=48.2M (2019, preferred rank) while the Wikipedia infobox gives a single total-like figure of ~43.9M (2023) with no L1/L2 split. Kept l1=25/total=44 since total matches the infobox closely, but the Wikidata L1 figure exceeding our total is unresolved.
hak.why: Infobox nation field states Hakka is a national language in Taiwan (statutory status), ours had empty official list

bho.why: Infobox nation field lists Fiji ('as Fiji Hindi'), and the official-by-label file confirms Fiji Hindi is official in Fiji; ours had empty official list. Hello fixed to Wiktionary's bho-specific entry 'प्रणाम' (pranam) since 'नमस्कार' wasn't attested for this language code

dv.why: Ours 'Kihineytha' means 'how are you', not hello; Wikivoyage/Wiktionary give assalaamu alaikum (formal) or maruhabaa (informal, also means welcome) for hello - used the informal form

bal.unsure: Wikivoyage lists a native-sounding goodbye romanization 'Wassh ent' (no script given) distinct from ours 'Khuda hafiz' (a Persian/Urdu loan phrase common across the region); could not confirm the native Balochi script for 'Wassh ent' or confirm 'Khuda hafiz' is actually wrong, so left unchanged.

ky.why: Ours 'Salamatta boluŋuz' doesn't match any attested Kyrgyz farewell; Wiktionary gives 'кош бол' (kosh bol) as goodbye, formalized here with the -uŋuz honorific matching ours' register

en.why: Expanded from 34 to 88 ADM0 codes using Wikidata official_in (sovereign states + inhabited dependent territories where English is official or official is a Natural Earth admin-0 entity in our countries list); excluded Netherlands (likely a Caribbean Netherlands tagging artifact, Dutch is official in mainland NL) and Spratly Islands (disputed, uninhabited).

bs.why: Infobox explicitly marks Montenegro '(co-official)' at the national level (also confirmed by Wikidata official_in); ours was missing Montenegro.

se.why: Infobox nation field lists Norway (unqualified) vs Finland listed under 'minority' with explicit regional-only caveat (Sami homeland municipalities); Norway's Sami Act grants Northern Sami national official status. Ours official list was empty.

gn.why: Infobox nation field and Wikidata official_in both list Bolivia alongside Paraguay (unqualified, national level); ours was missing Bolivia.

yua.why: Wikidata official_in and infobox nation both list Mexico (indigenous languages have national-language status under Mexico's linguistic rights law), ours was empty. Bye phrase replaced with Wikivoyage's attested farewell; ours 'Jach ma'alob k'iin' ('very good day') wasn't found in either reference.

pap.why: Infobox nation field also lists Bonaire (a special municipality of the Netherlands, no separate ADM0 code), where Papiamento has official/recognized status; Wikidata official_in also lists Netherlands. Ours was missing this.
